card.description: A coaching staff wants to predict the other team's next play. Each record is one real play from the 2023 NFL season. The label is Pass or Run. A pass throws the ball. A run carries it. You can also choose Team Won the Game? or Drive Scored? as the label.
card.source: nflverse play-by-play data, 2023 season (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/tag/pbp). Records hand-picked from real plays.

context.potentialUses: Help a coach guess if the other team will pass or run
context.potentialMisuses: It is trained on a small set of plays picked by people, so it can be wrong in game situations that have only a few records. Don't use it to judge a team or a coach.

fields.description: Which try is this? A team gets four tries, called downs, to move the ball 10 yards.
How far does the team need to go for a first down? Short is 1 to 3 yards, Medium is 4 to 6, Long is 7 or more.
Is the team with the ball winning, tied or losing?
Did the team score (a touchdown or field goal) on this drive? A drive is one turn with the ball.
Did the team with the ball win this game? You only know this after the game ends.
Did the team Pass or Run? This is what the app predicts.
